scenes.title: What Happens Before Takeoff?
scenes.text: Before a plane takes off, a whole team gets it ready, often in under an hour. It's like a pit stop at a car race! Let's watch what happens at the airport.

scenes.title: Your Suitcase's Journey
scenes.text: First, your suitcase gets a tag with a barcode. Scanners read the tag, and a maze of conveyor belts sends every bag to the right plane.

scenes.title: Loading the Hold
scenes.text: Ground crew drive the bags out on little trains of carts. Then a belt loader carries them up into the hold, under the cabin floor.

scenes.title: Filling Up
scenes.text: A fuel truck pumps fuel into tanks inside the wings. A big jet can carry as much fuel as a thousand bathtubs!

scenes.title: Food and Drinks
scenes.text: Meanwhile, a catering truck lifts its box right up to the door, with meals and drinks, while cleaners tidy up the cabin.

scenes.title: The Walk-Around
scenes.text: A pilot walks all the way around the plane, checking the tyres, the engines, and the flaps, to make sure everything looks just right.

scenes.title: Pushback
scenes.text: Doors closed! A small but mighty tug pushes the plane backwards, away from the gate, because airliners don't drive backwards on their own.

scenes.title: Cleared for Takeoff
scenes.text: Then the plane taxis out to the runway, and the control tower gives the final word: cleared for takeoff!

scenes.title: Remember!
scenes.text: Bags, fuel, food, checks, pushback, and the tower. That's what happens before takeoff! See you on the next flight.
